findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.comment:
Observed certified food protection manager certification of PIC to be expired. PIC has taken class, but still needs to take test. 

2-102.12: (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.citation_text: 4-602.13  (C) Soil residue present on side of refrigeration. Clean all non-food contact surfaces frequently to prevent soil accumulation.  Reference 4-602.13. Clean and maintain clean.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment: Personal food including shell eggs and sausage gravy are observed to be stored in the cooler which also holds food for the children. Provide barrier for personal food. Call with questions please. 750-120 At all times food shall be protected from potential contamination.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: Shelves of lazy Susan area of cabinet are soiled. Clean and maintain free of accumulated soil. 750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Storage/handling of clean equipment, utensils
findings.comment: Observed the utensil holders with spoons in the cabinet drawer to be soiled with dust and crumbs. Clean and maintain free of accumulated soil. 750-860 Cleaned and sanitized utensils an equipment shall be stored at least six inches above the floor in a clean, dry location in a way that protects them from contamination by splash, dust and other means.

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment: Observed two milk gallons to be open and in use with no date of open on the containers. Properly date milk and use or discard in 7 days. Milk was labeled. 750-151(a) Refrigerated potentially hazardous ready to eat food held at the establishment more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked with the date or day by which the food shall be consumed, sold, or discarded. Maximum holding time at 41°F is 7 days. Properly date mark food and do not hold longer than 7 days.

findings.title: Storage/handling of clean equipment, utensils
findings.comment: Observed clean utensils stored in a crock on the counter which is soiled with dust in the bottom. 750-860 Cleaned and sanitized utensils an equipment shall be stored at least six inches above the floor in a clean, dry location in a way that protects them from contamination by splash, dust and other means. Clean the ustensils and crock and maintain free of accumulated soil.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
750.800b - Inside the kitchen microwave was soiled with dried food splash. 

To prevent cross contamination and eliminate buildup of debris, clean and sanitize in microwaves between uses/as needed (Up to every 4hrs after continuous use).

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
750.800e - The canned good storage cabinets in the upstairs kitchen and downstairs kitchenette were both observed with buildup of dust/general debris.

Clean inside the aforementioned cabinets, and all other storage areas, as needed to eliminate buildup of dust/debris.

findings.title: Storage/handling of clean equipment, utensils
findings.citation_text:
750.850 - Utensils drying in dish rack after ware washing process were observed with food surfaces extended up out of the holder. Discussed washing hands and wearing single use gloves to remove utensils from the holder once dry. Utensils should be placed in the container with handles extended up or placed within the dish rack in a way that will allow for utensils to all face one direction so only handles are touched when being retrieved after drying process is complete.

Cleaned and sanitized utensils shall be stored and handled in a way that protects them from contamination.  Spoons, knives and forks shall be touched only by their handles.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.citation_text:
750.1120 - Paper towels were not available at the handsink. Paper towels were taken to the classroom and were returned to the kitchen.

Maintain a supply of paper towels and soap at the handsink at all times to allow for proper handwashing.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: 750.800b - Inside microwave observed with dried food splash on top, side, and bottom surfaces. Clean and sanitize inside the microwave between uses/as needed to prevent cross contamination and eliminate buildup of debris.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.citation_text: 750.1220 - Floor and coving around/under fridge/freezer unit was observed to have buildup of dust and some general debris. Owner noted the husband of one of the teachers has offered to come help with moving and cleaning under/around cold holding units at the facilities. Clean under/around the cold holding units as needed to eliminate buildup of dust and general debris.

findings.title: Hands washed, good hygienic practices (observed).
findings.citation_text: 750.510 & 512 - Employee put on a pair of single use gloves to help with food prep without first washing her hands. Employees were advised on proper handwashing prior to putting on gloves. Hands must be washed before putting on gloves, between glove changes, between tasks, and any time hands may have been contaminated. During handwashing process make sure paper towels are used to dry hands and use the paper towel to turn off faucet to avoid contaminating clean hands. **Do not use common cloth towels for wiping hands for any reason**                     **Proper handwashing technique from IL Food Code provided**

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.citation_text: 750.690 - A) Bottom edge above drawer in fridge was cracked/damaged. Repair the area so it is smooth and easily cleanble (seal crack with caulk, etc.). B) Back wall inside paint storage cabinet was damaged (below sanitize and handwashing sinks). The wall on the other side and exposed plumbing can be seen. Repair the wall & the cabinet so the area is properly sealed. Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Hand washing sinks installed, located, accessible
findings.citation_text: 750.1120 - Sink designated for handwashing was blocked by colander of raspberries. Employees were advised on proper use of handsinks. Handsinks are to be used only for handwashing and must be accessible to allow for proper handwashing at all times. Colander was moved to one of the compartments of 3 part sink to be rinsed. (see general comments)

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 750.800e - The following non-food contact surfaces were soiled: A) microwave shelves (dust/debris under both microwaves) & inside lazy Susan (dust buildup along edges). Clean the above items and all non-food contact surfaces daily/as needed to eliminate buildup of debris

findings.title: Storage/handling of clean equipment, utensils
findings.citation_text: 750.860 - Container holding serving utensils had a few pieces of what appeared to be some food debris and an old staple in the bottom. Also, utensil organizer in the drawer had some splash/debris on surfaces where clean utensils are stored. Cleaned and sanitized utensils/equipment shall be stored at least six inches above the floor in a clean, dry location in a way that protects them from contamination by splash, dust and other means. **Maintain storage containers, organizers, and drawers clean to protect utensils and equipment from potential contamination**

findings.title: Outer openings protected from insects, rodent proof
findings.citation_text: 750.1170 - Outer door in upstairs kitchen had a gap in the bottom left corner and along the sides in multiple spots. Door needs to be repaired so it is tight fitting and vermin proof. Openings to the outside shall be protected against the entrance of rodents and insects. **Check all outer doors and make necessary repairs to ensure all doors are tight fitting & vermin proof**

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.citation_text: 750.1200 & 1220 - A) Floors under both fridge/freezer units were soiled with dust & debris. Clean the floors under the fridge/freezer units. B) The frame to the upstairs kitchen outer door had areas of damage on both sides at the bottom where the frame meets the floor. Get the door frame repaired so the aforementioned areas are properly sealed to create a smooth, cleanable surface and eliminate potential hiding places for pests.
